name: Billy Maclure
summary: Billy Maclure is a mischievous young human boy living at the Maclure Vineyards in Elwynn Forest. Caught in the midst of a bitter feud between his family and the neighboring Stonefields, Billy's petty antics often cause trouble for both farms. His weakness for fresh pastries makes him easy to bribe when his shenanigans get out of hand.

sections.title: A Boy at the Vineyards
sections.body: Billy Maclure can usually be found loitering outside the barn at the Maclure Vineyards, not far from the farmer Gerard Tiller. Growing up amidst the endless rows of grapevines, Billy spends much of his time dodging chores and running wild across the rural meadows of central Elwynn Forest. Like the rest of his kin, he is keenly aware of the long-standing hostility between the Maclures and the Stonefields, though Billy treats the feud more like a game of pranks and petty theft than a serious conflict.

sections.title: The Stolen Necklace
sections.body: Billy's mischief crossed the line when he swiped a treasured heirloom necklace belonging to Auntie Bernice Stonefield. While dashing about near the perilous Fargodeep Mine, the frightened youngster lost his grip on the trinket. Before he could retrieve it, the necklace was snatched up by a particularly massive and vicious kobold named Goldtooth, who vanished back into the subterranean tunnels. Terrified of both the subterranean vermin and the wrath of the neighboring elders, Billy remains reluctant to confess until coaxed with a savory bribe—specifically, a hot pork belly pie baked by Auntie Bernice herself.

faq.answer: Billy Maclure is a young human child living at the Maclure Vineyards in Elwynn Forest. He spends his days dodging work around the farm, playing pranks, and aggravating the neighboring Stonefield family.

faq.q: Where can Billy Maclure be found?
faq.answer: Billy is stationed just outside the main barn on the grounds of the Maclure Vineyards, located in central Elwynn Forest to the southwest of the Stonefield Farm.

faq.q: What did Billy do to Auntie Bernice?
faq.answer: Billy snuck over to the Stonefield Farm and stole Auntie Bernice Stonefield's heirloom necklace as part of the ongoing feud between their families.

faq.q: What happened to the necklace Billy stole?
faq.answer: While playing carelessly near the entrance of Fargodeep Mine, Billy dropped the necklace. It was swiftly picked up by Goldtooth, a notorious and formidable kobold who carried it deep into the mine.

faq.q: How do you get Billy to confess what happened to the necklace?
faq.answer: Billy refuses to tell the truth out of stubbornness and fear of punishment, but he cannot resist his appetite. Offering him one of Auntie Bernice's freshly baked pork belly pies is enough to loosen his tongue.

Goldtooth is an exceptionally large and vicious kobold leader who nests inside Fargodeep Mine. He snatched Auntie Bernice's dropped necklace from near the mine's entrance and hoards it within the dark tunnels.

angles.text: Billy represents the grounded, everyday squabbles of the Elwynn countryside, showing that even with Stormwind's political turmoil, local farm feuds and childhood misbehavior carry on as usual.
For Alliance adventurers newly arrived from Northshire, assisting with Billy's foolish pranks provides an introduction to the dangers lurking in Fargodeep Mine.
Auntie Bernice's renowned pork belly pie demonstrates how simple frontier cooking can resolve tense local disputes and pry confessions from tight-lipped farm boys.
